scope:
Measure dynamic conditioning prefill plus the complete original shape sampler.

Experimental FP32 two-graph execution, retaining every checkpoint parameter,
token and original Euler/CFG operation. Exact prepared CPU trajectories and the
sealed stock CPU reference are checked before native compilation. Timing covers
two resident prefill calls plus all 21 synchronized denoiser calls; compilation,
warmups, raw-condition upload and artifact I/O are reported separately/excluded.
finding: Pretrained shape512 dynamic conditioning cache takes 15.948857s including 0.066751s native prefill and 15.882106s original12-step/21-call sampler, versus 16.865315s ordinary control (5.43% lower). Final stock-CPU relative error 0.299911 versus control 0.299911; strict gates pass: False. Every prepared CPU sampler state is bitwise ordinary. Every native sampler state is bitwise the ordinary native control. Both native graphs retain learned math/LoRA with no fallback/recompile. Full scene quality remains unverified; no production promotion.
timing_limit: Single complete trajectory each, not a latency distribution. Resident weights and preuploaded raw conditions. Candidate adds synchronized native prefill pair; both paths include x/t H2D, output D2H and original CPU Euler/CFG arithmetic. Compilation, warmups, reference/preparation and artifact I/O excluded. First-use prefix effects prevented by warming both branches.
quality_limit: Synthetic shape512, already-BF16-quantized weights promoted to FP32 and unchanged original stock FP32 gates. Not full-precision raw weights, a CUDA oracle, a real-scene geometry/material assessment or default1024 cascade.
decision: Keep execution opt-in while pursuing strict numerical gates and real-scene validation; do not promote a failing full trajectory even when faster.
tests: 12 focused CPU tests pass. Full pretrained CPU ordinary/cached trajectories match bitwise at every state; native trajectory matches the ordinary native control bitwise at every state. Physical checkpoint, shared source hashes, SDK versions, noise/coordinates/conditions and original sampler/config are verified. Strict stock-CPU gates remain failed.
